label: Texas auto liability minimum, bodily injury or death of one person
applies: The minimum coverage establishing financial responsibility through a motor vehicle liability insurance policy in Texas
note: Effective 1 January 2011, and the subsection carrying the earlier lower amounts is shown as expired, so material quoting lower figures is quoting a subsection that no longer operates. The statute also permits the coverage to exclude the first $250 of liability for bodily injury to one person.
author: Aaron Bollinger
